architecture_summary: React SPA with Vite. Frontend: 3 pages (Home, Catalog, Order Form). Backend: mock API routes in /api/*.js. State: React Context for cart. Routing: React Router v6. Styling: Tailwind CSS. No DB yet; mock data in src/data/*.json. Ponytail: replace mocks with real API when backend ready.

tickets.title: Scaffold App.jsx with navigation
tickets.description: Create root component. Set up React Router. Add navigation bar with links to Home, Catalog, Order Form. Include cart icon with badge showing item count.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar visible on all pages
Cart badge updates when items added/removed

tickets.title: Build Home screen
tickets.description: Create Home page. Hero banner with call-to-action. Featured items grid (3 items). How-it-works section (3 steps). Testimonials carousel. Footer with contact info.
acceptance_criteria: Featured items load from mock data

tickets.title: Build Catalog screen
tickets.description: Create Catalog page. Filter sidebar (category, price range). Product grid with pagination. Each product card show: image, name, price, add-to-cart button. Cart context update when item added.

tickets.title: Build Order Form screen
tickets.description: Create Order Form page. Multi-step form: 1) Cart review, 2) Shipping info, 3) Payment, 4) Confirmation. Form validation for all fields. Submit button disabled until valid. Mock API call on submit.
acceptance_criteria: Mock API call logs order data to console

tickets.title: Create mock data and API routes
tickets.description: Add mock data for products, testimonials. Create mock API routes for catalog fetch, order submit. Use Vite's built-in server for mock endpoints.
